title: Post Street Museum
summary: The Post Street Museum is a museum located in London, England and the base of operations for Montehue and his assistant, Tersly. The museum holds an impressive collection of historical treasures ranging from artworks to artifacts.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
In preparation for their mission, The Hammer of Thor, Dante Vale, Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill visited the Post Street Museum for Tersly's knowledge of Norse legends. Montehue was out playing racket ball during their visit. Sophie commented that the art collection made her feel close to her mother who apparently avidly collected art. They soon realized were being spied on by the Guardians of Thor and exited the museum to give chase. [The Legacy of Thor]

On their mission to King Solomon's mines, Montehue and Tersly recovered numerous priceless treasures to take with them to the museum, including the raiments of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba which later became vital to opening the vault and retrieving the Legendary Titan of Spirit, Tao. [To Be Together]
